[LSTO.2.2.1] A rule stores a fact by calling `record_fact` with it:
the service's one kwarg is declared `Schema` and takes a pattern binding
([LADP.8.6.1]). The service declares `no response` ([LADP.8.4.2]), so a stored
fact produces nothing and a failed store produces a `CallError`
([LCRS.17.1]). A rule that wants a fact both in working memory and stored
`emit`s it and stores the binding a later rule matches.
